name: Crown Guard Tower
summary: Crown Guard Tower is a ruined Lordaeron scout tower in the southern Eastern Plaguelands. The Scourge destroyed it during the invasion of Lordaeron in the Third War, and its broken stones have stood amid the blight ever since.

sections.title: A Fallen Bulwark
sections.body: Once part of the Kingdom of Lordaeron's defenses, Crown Guard Tower was a scout tower watching over the lands of eastern Lordaeron. When the Scourge overran the kingdom, the tower was destroyed and left in ruins, one of several fallen towers scattered across what are now the Eastern Plaguelands. Its charred stones stand in a land the undead still hold.

faq.q: What was Crown Guard Tower originally built for?
faq.answer: It served as a regional military watchtower and scout outpost for the human Kingdom of Lordaeron before the Third War, guarding the roads against incursions.
The tower was destroyed during the Scourge invasion of Lordaeron, when waves of undead overran the kingdom's defenses and left the structure in rubble.

angles.text: For the Alliance, the ruined Crown Guard Tower is a reminder of how completely the Scourge broke the Kingdom of Lordaeron's defenses.
